preset_description: All sliders at centre — baseline and null test
preset_notes: Every slider at the centre detent. The pedal should be close to a wire: this is the reference every other preset is compared with, and the calibration preset. A good flat take nulls almost completely against the send.

interface.main_knob: mark it: the Main knob sets the Out 1/2 level (verify)
interface.in1_gain: set during calibration (note the knob position)
